about_the_game:
Command a colony on the brink in Ants Megapolis. Survive an unforgiving world where predators, rival hives, and devastating natural disasters threaten your very existence. Your key to survival is your Pheromone, a weapon you forge through your actions to unlock terrifying soldiers or hyper-efficient workers. Carve out your empire from the dirt and rise to dominance as an interactive narrator chronicles your savage, epic story of survival.

FORGE YOUR COLONY'S IDENTITY WITH THE PHEROMONE TRIAD

Your playstyle shapes your colony's very essence. Every action, from gathering a leaf to defeating a foe, alters your unique Pheromone blend of Prosperity, Adaptation, and Dominance. This dynamic system directly impacts your colony's evolution, unlocking specialized units, advanced structures, and powerful passive bonuses. Will you lead a thriving economic powerhouse, an endlessly adaptable swarm, or a terrifying legion of conquerors? Your scent defines your destiny.

LIVE YOUR OWN INTERACTIVE NATURE DOCUMENTARY

You are not just a player; you are the subject of a living documentary. A charismatic narrator will chronicle your colony's saga, marveling at your triumphs and commenting with a sharp sense of humor on your failures. His guidance provides atmosphere, context, and a constant companion on your journey, transforming your gameplay into a truly compelling narrative experience.

BATTLE A DYNAMIC, HOSTILE WORLD

Your greatest enemy is often nature itself. The world is alive, unpredictable, and relentlessly hostile. Survive sudden, game-changing events like torrential floods that drown your outer chambers, scorching droughts that wither your food supply, and the ever-present threat of larger predators who operate on their own schedules. No two games are the same as you're forced to adapt your strategies to a world that actively fights back.

DESIGN AN UNDERGROUND MEGALOPOLIS

Become the architect of a sprawling colony that operates on two fronts. Establish a visible presence on the surface to dominate the landscape, while simultaneously carving out a hidden, underground city to secure your future. How you connect and defend your bi-level empire will determine its survival.

DOMINATE, SUBDUE, OR ALLY

Command legions of ants in fast-paced RTS combat when diplomacy fails. But brute force isn't the only path to victory. Develop your pheromones to project an aura of pure intimidation, causing weaker rivals to flee your territory without a fight. Or, take a more subtle approach: master the art of mimicry to forge alliances with other ant species, allowing you to share resources, technology, and even breed powerful hybrid units.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10x64 / Windows 11x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-14400F (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 3050 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Storage: 10 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Device
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • OS: Windows 11x64
  • Processor: Intel Core i7-14700KF (or equivalent)
  • Memory: 16 GB RAM
  • Graphics: RTX 5070 (or equivalent)
  • DirectX: Version 12
  • Storage: 16 MB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX Compatible Sound Device
